caption: The drawing depicts a U-shaped harness pad, likely for a horse, centered on a plain, beige background. The main fabric portion of the pad is red, bordered, and features a repeating chevron or zig-zag pattern in shades of beige, yellow, brown, and olive. The pad has two bands extending downward, each fitted with a beige leather strap and metal buckle, one on the left and one on the right. The top part of the pad has an attached curved handle made of beige leather or similar material, joining the upper corners. The edges of the pad are lined, and stitching details are visible throughout its fabric and leather parts. The composition is straightforward with the harness pad shown fully extended and symmetrically arranged, occupying the center of the minimal background.
title: Shawl Strap
